## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the microphone used for audio input from the table and pass it over.

Task description: The target is the microphone on the left side of the table with a gray mesh head and slim black handle. This round, the left arm picks it up and hands it to the right arm.

Success criteria: Move the microphone to the right of the robot centerline and lift it well clear of the table into the airborne handover region near the grippers' initial height or higher. The right gripper must be closed and actually holding it, and the left open and released.

## Execution tips

- The left gripper can grasp a section of the black handle near its tail end, keeping the full pads on the handle and leaving a section near the gray mesh head for the right gripper.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected handle section and enclose it from opposite sides across its width. Before closing, confirm the handle lies between the pads rather than merely overlapping in the image.
- For the handoff, offset the two grippers along the handle. Keep the left gripper supporting it until the right gripper has a secure hold, reducing gripper collision and the chance of dropping the microphone.
